name: manual_707139
claim: A merge or blend tool's own 'clean, no conflict' label for a file is not proof nothing was silently dropped -- independently diff base-commit..target-commit for every file the tool marks clean, not just the ones it flags as conflicts, to positively confirm upstream made zero changes there.

decisions.notes: Verified all 13 non-conflicting files in an agentic-stack vendor blend this way; generalizes this session's established verify-claims-not-labels discipline (previously applied to git branch state and agent self-reports) to merge-tool output specifically.
